title: Block (Shadow Hand in-hand reorientation, DexCube)
instance_note: setting 2 of the task (assets/setting_2.npz; fixed reset: scripts_fast TaskAdapter.reset ignores the seed and the IsaacLab reset is deterministic)

controller.name: Ours: symbol-guided predicate MPC (MILP_setting/scripts_fast/predicate_mpc.run_predicate_mpc)
controller.description: offline plan-word grammar from E2E-teacher demonstrations; per step a zero-LP bound-propagation search proposes H-step symbol words; each word psi=Wz is injected into the native problem's LP relaxation (conditioned LP, HiGHS); the best word's first action is executed

success_criterion: ||error|| <= 0.10 where error = rotation vector (rad) of R^T R_goal
video_note: Each control step = 2 physics sub-steps (1/120 s each). Every recorded sub-step pose is rendered exactly; 9 in-between frames per sub-step interpolate joint angles linearly and the object orientation by slerp (visual slow motion only). The first 30 frames hold the initial state and the last 45 hold the final state. The top-left inset shows the goal orientation rendered from the same camera.

camera.renderer: IsaacLab 2.3 / Isaac Sim 5.1 RTX (rgb annotator of the viewport camera), ground hidden, default dome light

object_visual: DexCube texture: faces carry letters (see faces[].texture_letter)
faces_note: Faces are fixed body-frame faces of the object, named after the side of the hand they face in the reference grasp; the names stay attached to the object as it rotates.

W_note: Unit rows: psi = W z selects 8 of the 20 binary factors; the other 12 are fixed by the flow constraints E z = e (3 units from source to sink), so psi determines z uniquely.

goal_contact_mode.note: z_reference[-1]: terminal contact mode rewarded by the MILP cost

graph.source: assets/symbol_graph_validated.json (validated) extended at run time by SymbolGraph.extended with executed nodes/transitions of successful demonstrations (origin=demo_extension)
graph.plan_note: plan_word = [current observed node, planned node for the next control interval] (H=2, receding horizon). Only the first action is executed; the next observed node comes from the physics (FlowMapper) and often differs from the planned one, after which the word is re-planned from the observed node.

timing_source: rat_ms / search_ms / ... per step come from the first camera-free timing run out/t3_block_s2_ours_r1.json (state trajectory bit-identical to the rendered run: True). Its rat_ms at step 0 includes the one-time LP model build (one_time_setup_ms). ours_ms_median / e2e_ms_median are per-step medians over 5 fresh-process runs with setup excluded (block_s2_timing.json).

steps.search_note: terminal state: success test passed, no decision taken

measured_nearest_face_note: Supplementary geometry: distance from each distal-link origin (not the fingertip surface) to the nearest object face, and the norm of the link's incoming joint force. The symbolic contacts above are the task's FlowMapper projection of this geometry onto a feasible contact flow.

timing_sync.note: Counter sync: at video frame steps[t].frame the controllers have taken decisions 0..t-1, so the cumulative decision time (setup excluded) is steps[t].ours_cum_ms_median / e2e_cum_ms_median; the decision taken at step t costs steps[t].ours_ms_median / e2e_ms_median and plays out between frame(t) and frame(t+1). The video shows OUR trajectory; E2E's numbers are from its own closed loop on the same instance (same number of steps).
